$A=P(1+i)^n$

$A=900\,000\left(1+\dfrac{0,068}{12}\right)^{3}$

$=\mathrm{R}\,915\,386,86$

$P=\dfrac{x\left[1-(1+i)^{-n}\right]}{i}$

$915\,386,86=\dfrac{10\,000\left[1-\left(1+\dfrac{0,068}{12}\right)^{-n}\right]}{\dfrac{0,068}{12}}$

$\left(1+\dfrac{0,068}{12}\right)^{-n}=0,4812\ldots$

$-n=\log_{1,005\ldots}0,4812\ldots$

$n=129,419\ldots$ months

$\therefore 132,419$ months since the loan was granted

$\therefore 133$ months since the loan was granted
